about:
# EVIL Rises

EVIL Rises adds a guild Bounty Board to the standard Guild & Communities window in WoW Forever. Select the skull icon below the built-in tabs on the right, or type `/evil`.

Choose **Post a bounty** and enter a character name, use your current target, or right-click a player portrait and choose **Create bounty**. Choose a faction, select **Kill on sight**, **Camp**, or both, and set the gold, silver, and copper reward. Add a reason if you want guildmates to know the story.

Whisper the poster to agree on completion and payment. Posters withdraw their own listings once settled. Open listings expire seven days after posting. Guildmates running this generation of EVIL Rises exchange updates automatically.

## Crafting Orders

Select the crate beneath the Bounty Board. Search **Recipes** by name or profession, filter by guild coverage, or select a member under **Crafters** to browse what they know. Open a recipe for its materials and source. For recipes that produce an item, choose a quantity, who supplies materials, an optional tip, and either a specific crafter or the whole guild.

Under **Orders**, switch between your requests, orders assigned to you, and open requests you can craft. Accept or decline a request, record materials, and mark delivery complete. Guildmates running version 0.5.4 share profession and order updates automatically.

## Member profiles

Left-click a guildmate in the member list to open their native details card and attached gear flyout. Hover over an equipped slot for its item tooltip or drag the model to rotate it. A visible character uses their live appearance. Away or offline members can show a model dressed from their last shared equipment. Profession ranks appear when available. Version 0.5.7 shares each character�s carried gold, silver, and copper with guildmates running EVIL Rises. The flyout shows their last shared balance while offline. Use **Hide gear & professions** beneath the card to collapse the flyout.

## Install

Extract the release ZIP into `World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/` and reload the interface. When upgrading manually, replace the old `EVILRises` addon folder. Existing saved variables can stay in place. Use `/evil version` to check the installed version.
## Raid night and guild business

- **Chat** opens guild chat. Members who can read officer chat get a second channel there. A filled gold roster crown marks the guild master, and a gold outline marks ranks with officer permissions.
- **Guild** keeps the calendar, polls, and bulletin together. Under **Raids** you'll find sessions and attendance. Under **Loot** you'll find wishlists, standings, and loot history.
- **Alliances** holds guild pacts, allied bulletins, and chat.
- **Recruitment** and **Leadership** give officers tools for trials, ranks, officer notes, and the audit log. Available actions depend on guild permissions.

Guildmates running EVIL Rises sync automatically at login, every 60 seconds, and when they open the guild window. If you missed a bounty or its withdrawal while offline, your board can catch up when the author is back online.

If a guildmate runs a newer version of EVIL Rises than you, a reminder to update appears in your chat window, then again every 30 minutes until you update. Only you see it.

## Commands and options

- `/evil` or `/evilrises` opens or closes the guild window. Your guild keybind and guild menu button work too.
- `/evil version` shows the installed addon version.
- `/evil debug` opens or closes the debug log. It lists the addon's last 500 events since login: sync messages sent and received, messages it ignored and why, and actions such as posting a bounty or accepting a craft order. Tick **Sync only** to see just the sync traffic, choose **Copy log** and press Ctrl+C to copy it into a bug report, or choose **Pause** to stop recording.

## Download and install

[Download the EVIL Rises ZIP from GitHub Releases](https://github.com/alienvisa/EVIL-Rises/releases/latest). With the game closed, unzip the download and copy the `EVILRises` folder into `World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/`. Check that `AddOns/EVILRises/EVILRises.toc` is in place, then enable **EVIL Rises** in the character screen's AddOns list.

Found a bug or have an idea for the guild? [Open an issue on GitHub](https://github.com/alienvisa/EVIL-Rises/issues).

*Stay ticklin and stay evil.*

## Contributing and releases

Use a Conventional Commit PR title, such as `feat(roster): add filters` or
`fix: repair guild sync`, to choose the release bump. Prefer squash merging with
the PR title as the commit subject. GitHub's default merge commit also carries
the PR title on the first line of its body. PR CI previews the bump from the
title and checks Lua 5.1 syntax, guild sync, bounty expiry, chat permissions, versioning, release recovery, and
the install ZIP.

In GitHub, enable squash merging, set the default squash commit message to
**Pull request title and description**, and disable merge commits and rebase
merging. Protect `main` by requiring a pull request and the **Tests** status check
from PR CI. Put any `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer in the PR description so it carries
through to the squash commit.

After CI passes on `main`, the workflow builds and validates a versioned ZIP with
BigWigs and stages it on a draft GitHub release. It uploads that exact ZIP to
CurseForge and publishes the GitHub draft after validating the upload receipt
and ZIP checksum. Set the `CF_PROJECT_ID` repository variable and the
`CF_API_TOKEN` secret before enabling publishing.

Pushes to `main` trigger publishing after CI passes. The latest stable Git tag
sets the version baseline. A Conventional Commit with `!` or a `BREAKING CHANGE:`
footer selects a major bump. A `feat` title selects a minor bump. Other messages,
including ordinary commit titles, default to patch. The largest bump applies if
several commits accumulated since the last release.

After publishing, GitHub Actions opens or updates a PR to sync the version in
`EVILRises/EVILRises.toc`. Enable **Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull
requests** in **Settings → Actions → General**. Approve the bot PR's CI run if
GitHub requires it, then merge the PR with its original title. A merge that only
syncs the TOC version does not publish another release.

### Recovering a release

Rerun the original release job. It reuses the staged ZIP and any valid
`curseforge-upload.json` receipt. A push to `main` also resumes the pending
release from its original tag before allocating another version. If staging
never finished, the job rebuilds from that tagged commit.

If the job reports an unconfirmed CurseForge upload, inspect the project's
upload history, including pending files, and the run's **release-files** artifact:

- If the artifact contains `curseforge-upload.json`, attach it to the draft and
  rerun the job.
- If CurseForge accepted the exact staged ZIP and the receipt was lost, verify
  the file against the staged ZIP, add its numeric CurseForge file ID as `id`
  to a copy of the draft's `curseforge-attempt.json`, and attach that copy as
  `curseforge-upload.json`. Rerun the job.
- If you confirm CurseForge accepted no file, remove `curseforge-attempt.json`
  from the draft and rerun the job.

releases.notes:
# EVIL Rises

## [v0.10.0](https://github.com/alienvisa/EVIL-Rises/tree/v0.10.0) (2026-11-27)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/alienvisa/EVIL-Rises/compare/v0.9.1...v0.10.0) 

- feat(sync): reliable guild sync that repairs lost messages in every area (#34)  
    * feat(sync): one named-field message format shared by every sync area  
    Add Comm.lua, a single transport for Bounty, professions, craft orders and  
    gear. Each message is one table (protocol, guild, area, action, payload,  
    addon version, recipient, capabilities) on the new EVRSync2 prefix, so  
    fields can be added without breaking older copies.  
    Clients announce which areas they understand on their first message, at  
    most every 10 minutes after that, and when they hear a new guildmate.  
    0.9.0 clients keep working: every message is also sent in the old format,  
    marked as a copy so newer clients read it once, for 15 minutes after login  
    and for an hour after an older client was last heard.  
    Tests: new SyncFormats suite with a real 0.9.0 client from tests/legacy;  
    test mocks now route AceComm messages by prefix.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
    * feat(orders): repair lost craft-order actions from periodic summaries  
    Every 3 minutes each member lists the orders it speaks for (placed, taken,  
    released or declined, running or closed within a day). A guildmate whose  
    copy differs asks for those orders; the holder answers every asker in one  
    message after 3 seconds, and the receiver replays the missed acceptance,  
    release, decline, materials, completion or cancellation through Apply.  
    Two acceptances at once that a copy heard only one of are settled by the  
    same earlier-wins rule, so the race loser learns it lost. A difference  
    that cannot be settled is asked about three times at most.  
    Order messages now go at NORMAL priority instead of BULK, and the new  
    sum/get/fix actions are sent in the new format only (craftorder  
    capability 2).  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
    * feat(sync): gear, Bounty and professions on the shared repair loop, replies by whisper  
    - Repair.lua: the shared ask and answer bookkeeping. An Asker asks once per version  
      of an entry, re-asks when no answer came and stops after a limit; a Gather collects  
      requests for a few seconds and answers one asker by itself, or the whole guild.  
      Craft orders, professions, Bounty and gear all use it.  
    - Gear: every member says how new its own snapshot is every 10 minutes; a guildmate  
      holding an older one, or none, asks for it, and gets it by whisper.  
    - Bounty: a member behind on a sheet asks its author directly, and the author answers  
      one asker by whisper, several on the guild channel.  
    - Comm: a message for one member goes by whisper when that member sends the current  
      format, and on the guild channel otherwise. A bounced whisper is sent again on the  
      guild channel, and that member gets guild messages for an hour. A whisper is read  
      only from a member heard on the guild channel in this guild.  
    - tests/AreaRepair.lua: lost gear and sheets repaired, routing, bounce fallback and  
      strangers' whispers; test transports deliver a whisper to its target only.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
    * test(sync): simulated-guild convergence suite, and the order races it found  
    - tests/SyncConvergence.lua: five members on the current format and one on 0.9.0  
      share a fake guild channel; for four minutes 20% of new-format messages are lost  
      per receiver and every member hears them in a random order, with an accept race,  
      a missed accept and release, a release handed to another crafter and a late login.  
      After fifteen calm minutes every member must hold the same orders, Bounty sheets,  
      recipe lists and gear. Twelve seeds run in CI; 200 pass locally.  
    - tests/legacy now holds every sync file that changed since 0.9.0, so the old client  
      in this suite and in SyncFormats is a real 0.9.0 client.  
    - Orders: two acceptances at once settle the same way in any state, not only while  
      accepted (a copy that missed one may have heard the materials or completion  
      first). Summaries carry the acceptance time for that. Only the winner's own copy  
      settles it: the author's may predate the winner giving the order back. A crafter  
      whose own copy now names someone else is taken to have released it.  
    - Repair.Asker: after its ask limit an entry rests for 30 minutes and is then asked  
      about again, so one whose answers were all lost is still repaired.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
    * fix(crafting): start crafting and gear sync at login on WoW: Forever  
    The client has no CLUBS\_LOADED event and rejects it with an error. Registering it  
    threw before the handler was set, so no login or guild event ever bound crafting  
    and gear sync: professions, orders and gear stayed silent until the Crafting  
    Orders tab was opened. The handler now goes on first, and each event registers  
    through Compat.RegisterEvent, which ignores an event the client lacks.  
    tests/LoginEvents.lua loads the addon on a client that rejects CLUBS\_LOADED and  
    checks that sync binds, the professions summary and orders ask go out, and own  
    gear is shared, all from login alone.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
    ---------  
    Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- chore(release): sync TOC to v0.9.1 (#33)  
    Co-authored-by: alienvisa <79223061+alienvisa@users.noreply.github.com>

releases.notes:
# EVIL Rises

## [v0.9.0](https://github.com/alienvisa/EVIL-Rises/tree/v0.9.0) (2026-11-27)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/alienvisa/EVIL-Rises/compare/v0.8.1...v0.9.0) 

- feat: update reminder, live gear models and rebuilt Crafting Orders page (#26)  
    * ci: run bounty expiry and chat permission Lua tests  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
    Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session\_01QmyfV1bBV7ccN75jijKpN9  
    * perf: cut sync traffic and redraws, remove dead crafting code  
    - Share funds changes after 30 seconds instead of on every coin change.  
      Gear changes and guildmates' requests still go out within a second.  
    - Redraw the crafting page once per frame instead of once per changed  
      record during a sync burst.  
    - Ask the guild for professions and craft orders once at login, not twice.  
    - Declare all saved variables on one SavedVariables line in the TOC.  
    - Remove unused functions and aliases, the never-written reagent and yield  
      fallbacks, and comments describing the previous addon.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
    Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session\_01QmyfV1bBV7ccN75jijKpN9  
    * fix(gear): share the player's model ID once the model has loaded  
    The model ID was read right after SetUnit, before the model finished  
    loading, so snapshots often went out without an appearance and every  
    later snapshot kept the empty value. Guildmates then saw "No appearance  
    shared yet" instead of a 3D model.  
    Read the ID when the probe reports OnModelLoaded and share a new snapshot  
    when it arrives. Keep the probe on screen at zero alpha, reload it on  
    login and model changes instead of on every snapshot, and cover a late  
    model load in the gear test.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
    Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session\_01QmyfV1bBV7ccN75jijKpN9  
    * feat(debug): add /evil debug with a log of sync traffic and addon events  
    Debug.lua keeps the last 500 addon events from login and shows them in a  
    movable window opened by /evil debug. Sync messages are tagged In, Out or  
    Drop, with the sender or recipient, the message kind and size, and why a  
    message was ignored. Addon events cover bounty posts, withdrawals and  
    expiry, craft order actions, trades and mail, profession lists, gear  
    snapshots and model loads, the guild bind and the window tabs.  
    The window can pause recording, show sync lines only, copy the whole log  
    as plain text, and clear it. Esc closes it.  
    Also register /evilrises, which the README already listed, and drop the  
    README's pointer to the old settings debug window.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
    Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session\_01QmyfV1bBV7ccN75jijKpN9  
    * docs: remove the stale tab-dragging and resize bullet from the README  
    The redesigned addon lives inside the native Guild & Communities window,  
    which has no draggable tabs, resize grip or size lock.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
    Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session\_01QmyfV1bBV7ccN75jijKpN9  
    * feat: remind out-of-date players to update, and share race for gear models  
    Update reminder  
    - Every sync message now carries the sender's addon version as a trailing  
      value, which older clients ignore.  
    - When a guildmate runs a newer version, the player sees a chat reminder  
      10 seconds later, naming the newest version heard and their own, then  
      every 30 minutes while they stay out of date. Only the player sees it.  
    - Versions must be three numbers of up to three digits each.  
    Gear models  
    - Snapshots now carry the player's race and sex. The flyout builds a  
      guildmate's model from them with SetCustomRace and dresses it in their  
      shared gear, falling back to the model ID from older versions. The  
      client may not report a model ID for a model drawn from a live unit,  
      which left guildmates with "No appearance shared yet".  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
    Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session\_01QmyfV1bBV7ccN75jijKpN9  
    * feat(gear): exact live models nearby, worn outfits and remembered sightings  
    Live models  
    - The flyout also finds guildmates by their nameplate, so anyone close  
      enough to have one is drawn live, exactly as they look.  
    Worn outfits  
    - The probe model reports the player's outfit as worn: each slot's  
      appearance, secondary appearance and enchant effect. Snapshots carry it,  
      and previews put it on with SetItemTransmogInfo, falling back to the  
      equipped items when a snapshot or the client has no outfit.  
    Remembered sightings  
    - When the flyout draws a guildmate live, it saves their race, sex, outfit  
      and visible items locally, at most once every 5 minutes each. Out of  
      range, the flyout draws the newer of that sighting and their own  
      snapshot, so guildmates without the addon also get a preview.  
    Keeping the load low  
    - Model reloads after equipment and transmog changes are debounced, and an  
      update only goes out when the snapshot differs from the last one.  
    - Target, focus, mouseover, nameplate and model events redraw the flyout  
      only when they concern the member it shows.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
    Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session\_01QmyfV1bBV7ccN75jijKpN9  
    * feat(crafting): rebuild the Crafting Orders page on the native look  
    - Recipes, Crafters and Orders are native top tabs over an inset, like the  
      game's own windows. The Orders tab shows how many orders wait on you.  
    - A toolbar with the standard search box, the profession and filter menus,  
      and the result count on the right.  
    - Rows show the item or spell icon, the item name in its quality color,  
      and details on the right: the profession, skill and crafter count; a  
      crafter's level and recipe count in their class color, grayed when  
      offline; an order's state in color with the requester or crafter.  
      Hovering shows the item or spell tooltip; empty lists say why.  
    - A recipe opens with its icon, reagents with how many you carry for the  
      quantity entered, crafters by online status, and where it is learned.  
      The order form takes the tip in gold, silver and copper.  
    - An order shows its progress (Placed, Accepted, Materials sent,  
      Completed), who asked and who crafts, materials, tip, note and reagents,  
      with its actions along the bottom.  
    - A crafter's recipes and a recipe opened from them each have a Back  
      button to where they came from.  
    - Any template the client lacks falls back to a plain control.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
    Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session\_01QmyfV1bBV7ccN75jijKpN9  
    ---------  
    Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
